messages:
Maya: Quick question — thinking about adding a "silent" fallback mode that routes a percentage of traffic to lower-cost model variants without surfacing as a user-facing degrade. Thoughts?

Sahil: Generally +1 for an experimental quiet mode, but we need clear audit trails and hard rate-limits. Customers must be able to opt out. How are we defining 'silent' for telemetry/alerts?

Tess: +1 to Sahil. 'Silent' should mean no UI banner / no customer-facing notice, NOT no alerts. If SLA breaches happen we still bubble up. Also need to define sampling window so we don't hide oscillations.

Liam: API surface idea: `?fallback_mode=silent|visible` or header `X-Fallback-Mode: silent`. Default = visible for hosted, silent only opt-in. For Dedicated/Private provide org-level toggle.

Priya: Product idea — console slider to set % of traffic for silent fallback + a "spy" option that logs decisions but doesn't actually route. Good for dry-run canaries.

Maya: Important: decision_trace storage. We should persist per-decision fields: `model_from`, `model_to`, `reason`, `trigger`, `trace_id`, `latency_ms`, `sampled_request_id`. Retention configurable per org.

Sahil: Telemetry event: `fallback.decision` with low-cardinality tags `trigger_type`, `error_code` (if any), `model_variant`, `route`. Emit counts for sampling. Keep payload small.

Tess: Audit/compliance note — some customers will request full playback of decisions. We need an export API and masking options for PII before handing logs over. Also RBAC gating for viewing decision_trace.

deploy-bot: deploy 1777777788: rollout-config-service updated — added `fallback_mode` enum and `decision_trace` flag (default retention 30d).

Liam: Edge case: oscillation. If silent fallback increases error rates we need auto-revert. Propose `oscillation_protection` with cool-off windows, min duration, and hysteresis thresholds.

Maya: Console UX: show silent-fallback activity as a separate timeline (no banner) with a breadcrumb that opens the decision log for that timeslice. Add a "replay sample" button to run a captured request on both variants.

Priya: Also add a short help tooltip: "Silent fallback routes selected traffic to a different model without showing a downgrade to end users. Still respects SLA alerts." Include wording for Enterprise legal about auditability.

Sahil: Next steps: I'll open PRs for API param + telemetry schema. @Tess can you own security review? Maya — can you do a quick console mock to attach to the PR?

Maya: Yep, will drop a mock tomorrow morning and include the replay UX.

Tess: I'll pair with Sahil on the security checklist and DM infra for retention sizing.

Priya: I'll draft the product/help blurb and add a docs PR once API is merged.

Liam: Add unit tests for oscillation protection and a small e2e that verifies the spy/dry-run mode doesn't change routing.

Maya: Great. Low-risk plan: feature-flag behind org opt-in, telemetry + audit by default, enterprise retention opt-outs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
